content.summary: A six-shot synthetic passage moves from an intimate warm-lit point of view to a daylight wide frame, a backlit macro detail, layered depth, an uncertain subjective angle, and a final deliberately under-described frame.
content.viewer_path: Warm close-up establishes the viewer-position detail → Wide daylight scale gives way to a backlit macro detail → Layered depth exposes the reader and exit → A bounded uncertain reflection changes the viewpoint → The final under-exposed frame remains deliberately unresolved

timescript.what_visible: A gloved hand and compass fill a close-up from the viewer's eye line. The hand steadies the compass beside the doorway. The opening establishes an intimate viewer-position frame.
timescript.moment_note: Shot 1 advances the bounded synthetic visual progression.

timescript.what_visible: A wide daylight courtyard is seen from above with a small figure near the center. The figure crosses the open space. The view cuts from intimate interior detail to exterior scale.
timescript.moment_note: Shot 2 advances the bounded synthetic visual progression.

timescript.what_visible: A macro detail isolates the compass needle as a bright rim outlines its silhouette. The needle settles toward one engraved mark. Scale collapses from the courtyard to a single mechanical detail.
timescript.moment_note: Shot 3 advances the bounded synthetic visual progression.

timescript.what_visible: A chain occupies the foreground, the reader and map sit in the midground, and a bright doorway closes the background. The reader traces a route across the map. The image expands into three observable depth planes.
timescript.moment_note: Shot 4 advances the bounded synthetic visual progression.

timescript.what_visible: A tilted reflection suggests a subjective view, but the exact camera position remains uncertain. The reader turns toward the mirror. The stable objective view gives way to a bounded uncertain viewpoint.
timescript.moment_note: Shot 5 advances the bounded synthetic visual progression.

timescript.what_visible: The final frame shows an indistinct figure near a dark doorway; cinematography details are unavailable. The figure remains indistinct as the passage ends. The sequence ends without inventing unavailable visual detail.
